strings.name: Jan Koum
strings.summary: Born in Soviet-era Kyiv, Koum emigrated to the United States as a teenager and worked on Yahoo infrastructure. He developed WhatsApp with Brian Acton in 2009, widening access to cross-border mobile messaging. Facebook acquired the company in 2014; end-to-end encryption expanded in 2016. He left in 2018 and subsequently supported medical, educational and Jewish-community projects through philanthropy.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded WhatsApp, expanding cross-border mobile instant messaging and influencing personal social communication and digital-communications services.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born 24 February 1976 in Kyiv, then in the Ukrainian SSR, Soviet Union.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Attended San Jose State; left university after joining Yahoo, without completing a degree there.
strings.highlights.h1.title: WhatsApp
strings.highlights.h1.text: Built a cross-platform mobile messaging service with Acton, widening access to international communication.
strings.highlights.h2.title: End-to-end encryption
strings.highlights.h2.text: During his tenure, teams and technical partners expanded end-to-end encryption for messages and calls.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Medical donation
strings.timeline.t1.text: The Koum Family Foundation donated $200 million to Jerusalem’s Shaare Zedek for a planned medical tower.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Left WhatsApp
strings.timeline.t2.text: Announced his departure and exit from Facebook’s board; reporting described privacy and commercialization disagreements.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Encryption rollout
strings.timeline.t3.text: WhatsApp announced end-to-end encryption across messages and calls.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Facebook acquisition
strings.timeline.t4.text: Facebook announced its WhatsApp acquisition, with Koum joining its board.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Founded WhatsApp
strings.timeline.t5.text: Established WhatsApp, gradually converting a status application into a messaging tool.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Left Yahoo
strings.timeline.t6.text: Ended infrastructure-engineering work at Yahoo, departing with Acton.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Joined Yahoo
strings.timeline.t7.text: Joined Yahoo, subsequently leaving university for full-time infrastructure engineering.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Emigrated
strings.timeline.t8.text: Moved with his mother and grandmother to Mountain View, California, aged 16.
